links.outcome: LLM alignment with nephrologist consensus on kidney biopsy decision questions
links.effect: Best models (ChatGPT-3.5, GPT-4) agreed with human mode on only 6 of 11 questions; Llama 2 and MS Copilot on 2 of 11. Propensity scores ranged from 11 (MedLM) to 34 (Claude 3).
links.quote: In terms of agreement with the human mode, ChatGPT-3.5 and GPT-4 (OpenAI) had the highest levels of alignment, agreeing with the human mode on 6 out of 11 questions.

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing 8 LLMs to clinical survey responses from over 1,000 nephrologists regarding clinical decision-making on kidney biopsy indications/contraindications without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
